findings.title: Israeli strikes kill eight people in Gaza - medics say
findings.location: Western Khan Younis, southern Gaza Strip; likely corresponds to the previously reported al-Mawasi strike
findings.affected_population_system: Five Palestinians previously reported killed in a Khan Younis strike are newly described by Gaza's Hamas-run interior ministry as police officers. Reuters also reports that the Israeli military acknowledged striking several people it described as militants in Khan Younis, without further information. Police affiliation is attributed to the interior ministry; it does not establish combatant/civilian status. No additional deaths, injuries, or separate strike are asserted.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: the five police officers were killed in another strike in western Khan Younis
findings.source_type: Established international news agency citing medics, Gaza interior ministry, and Israeli military
findings.confidence: medium-high for traceable new victim-affiliation claim and Israeli military acknowledgment; unresolved identification and civilian/combatant status
